EXACT LICENSE ELECTION / LICENCIA EXACTA ELEGIDA
For this modified package we elect and preserve the Artistic License,
Version 2.0beta4, October 2000, exactly as included in License-original.txt.
The original README calls the release GPL/Artistic 2.0; the supplied text
contains the beta4 text and a Perl6 proposal mentioning GPL version 1 or
later. We do not replace that file with Artistic 2.0 final, do not mark these
samples CC0, and do not rely on interpreting the appended Perl6 proposal as
a separate, unambiguous GPL grant for these sound recordings.

The operational redistribution route used here is sections 4(c) and 6(a):
changes are identified and corresponding editable source plus recipes are
provided. Recipients are explicitly permitted and encouraged to make these
modifications Freely Available under the same included license. Original
notices and disclaimers are preserved verbatim. Section 7 permits aggregation
with other packages; this notice imposes no new license fee. The separate
player and CC0 input packages merely use these samples (section 9).

These statements describe the package's distribution terms and our chosen
compliance route; they do not assert that beta4 is the stable Artistic 2.0.

COMPLETE SOURCE DOWNLOAD / DESCARGA DE FUENTES
The local/public source bundle is ../sordino-source.zip, relative to this
directory, or assets/audio/sordino-source.zip relative to the app root.
Public direct link:
https://pulso-tierra-rgb-anton.akisunshin.chatgpt.site/assets/audio/sordino-source.zip
Download and unzip it in any folder. It includes the full original 22.6 MB
tar.bz2 (containing the original editable SF2 and its README/license), this
notice, the exact original notices, and portable extraction/encoding and
forest-composition recipes. This is source delivery, not a promise to email
source on request. It is not necessary to download source to play the app.

Original archive SHA-256:

Original SF2 SHA-256:

MODIFICATIONS / CAMBIOS
Renamed derivative package: Pulso Tierra - Bukvic muted violin extraction.
Selected original SF2 PCM recordings: G3, Bb3, C#4, D4 and A4. We did not
select the _limit variations. Selected MIDI roots: 55, 58, 61, 62, 69.
Public IDs: muted_violin_g3, muted_violin_bb3, muted_violin_cs4,
muted_violin_d4, muted_violin_a4; bank instrument family: mutedstrings.

rebuild_samples.py reads PCM directly from the complete original SF2,
writes mono PCM16 WAV at 44.1 kHz, and normalizes peak to 0.85. The browser
variants retain the first six seconds, apply a 150 ms fade-out, and encode
MP3 mono 44.1 kHz / 160 kbit/s using FFmpeg/libmp3lame. No artificial mute
filter or oscillator was used. Python 3 and NumPy rebuild WAV; FFmpeg in
PATH additionally encodes MP3. FFmpeg/NumPy are separate tools, not included
or relicensed by this source package. Encoder versions may change MP3 bytes.

Example:
python rebuild_samples.py --archive violin_sordino.tar.bz2 --out rebuilt
python fetch_cc0_sources.py --out cc0-inputs
python compose_forest_muted.py --muted-dir rebuilt --cc0-dir cc0-inputs --out bosque-cuerdas-vientos.wav

The HISTORICAL Python forest preview uses original motifs, time envelopes, stereo placement,
resampling/transposition and mixing of the actual muted violin plus CC0
flute/clarinet recordings. Its Bukvic-derived arrangement and rendered audio
are distributed under this same Artistic License Version 2.0beta4, not CC0.
The CC0 input recordings retain their own CC0 status. Their pinned upstream
source URLs, original hashes and preparation recipe are in cc0-inputs.json
and fetch_cc0_sources.py. They remain separate CC0 packages. The source
bundle omits duplicate CC0 WAVs to fit the hosting file-size limit; the helper
downloads and validates their original source recordings and prepares them.
See the composition recipe for exact events and source selection.

The individual Bukvic samples, extraction recipe, modified data and original
contributions to the forest derivative remain under the included beta4
license. Other original Pulso Tierra motifs without Bukvic-derived material
may be CC0 as declared individually in licencias.json. CC BY heartbeat data
also retain their separate original license.

ARTICULATION AND LIMITS / ARTICULACIÓN Y LÍMITES
The author's announcement and README identify a real con-sordino violin;
the announcement describes straight tone / no vibrato. This resolves the
previous lack of recorded muted strings. It is one recorded violinist, not
a complete orchestral section. Source dynamic piano/pp is not specified;
softness is a playback/mixing choice. The notes are approximately 8–14 cents
sharp relative to A4=440 Hz; MIDI roots are measured, not blindly copied from
generic SF2 originalPitch values. No recording of Wagner is included. No
human listening test is asserted by this notice.

CURRENT PLAYER / PREVIEW REVISION — NOVEMBER 2026
The current published forest preview is regenerated by the actual app engine
through OfflineAudioContext, not by the historical Python mixing recipe.
current-engine/ contains the complete frozen engine, policy, 46-entry bank,
encoder generator, exact rendering events/settings and reproduction notes.
The engine and source hashes are recorded in source-files.json.

Progressive musical tension is an original expressive layer based on the
absolute local temperature anomaly: zero added tension through 0.5 C, linear
increase to full tension at 2 C. It may alter harmony, envelopes, continuity
and fragmentation, with the same recorded instrument families. The muted
violin derivative and new forest arrangement/rendering remain under the
Artistic License Version 2.0beta4 supplied here; these new original forest
contributions are not dedicated to CC0.

Water playback additionally starts one second into the genuine bowed sample
for a sustained attack region; the original sample WAV is not changed.
Preview MP3 delivery: constant gain scales each raw preview WAV peak to 0.8,
with a 60 ms final fade, then MP3/libmp3lame 160 kbit/s at 44.1 kHz. This changes
preview-file presentation level, not the original app mix or the raw Web
Audio WAV; it preserves internal dynamics except for the final fade.

The exact current event recipe is current-engine/render-recipes.json.
Economy remains the industrial march at 90 BPM. Values are local anomaly
examples, not quantitative global warming scenarios or inferred pixel damage.
The source package deliberately excludes QA baseline fixtures and temporary
local HTTP test infrastructure.

CURRENT ANTO UPDATE — DESHIELO REPLACES FOOD
Active bank: 50 samples, version 3. Current engine SHA-256:

The original Bukvic tar archive, exact notices, modified muted-violin sources
and forest license remain unchanged. The nine retained Anto previews keep
their previous bytes and original renderer provenance. Only the food preview
is replaced by the byte-identical Sun Deshielo MP3, without re-encoding.
Current sources/events are in current-engine/; the former published renderer
for retained previews is in retained-previews-engine/. Ice source metadata,
CC0 notices, processing and original Sun recipe are in ice-source/.
No actual glacier recording is claimed. The active app still has 8 categories;
no regional or other-seven-theme changes from Sun were imported.
